steps.title: Prep & Mix: Tall Skoleboller
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the milk until it's lukewarm. Add the yeast and dissolve. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches. Incorporate {m53119_1}, {m53119_2}, {m53119_3}, and {m53119_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the sugar, cardamom, vanilla, and about 2/3 of the flour. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53119_5}, {m53119_6}, {m53119_7}, {m53119_8}, {m53119_9}, {m53119_10}, {m53119_11}, {m53119_12}, {m53119_13}, {m53119_14}, and {m53119_15} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix the dough together either by hand or in a mixer with a dough hook, slowly adding the rest of the flour. You might need a bit more or less flour to form dough that isn't too sticky to knead. When the dough forms a nice ball, add the softened butter and continue to knead the dough for about ten minutes.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll the dough into a cylinder and cut into six equal parts. Roll each piece into a round bun and set them in a greased muffin/cake tin. Cover and let rise until doubled in size (about an hour).
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.
